name: Hi-Clearance Inc.
summary: Established in 1989 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, Hi-Clearance Inc. is a prominent supplier of medical devices and associated services throughout Taiwan. The company's comprehensive product range addresses various healthcare sectors, including renal care, cardiac health, radiation therapy, dentistry, oral surgery, and metabolic conditions. Its medical offerings encompass vital equipment such as dialyzers, dialysis machines, and reverse osmosis (RO) systems, complemented by essential consumables and pharmaceutical products. Hi-Clearance also provides specialized devices for interventional cardiology, radiology, and vascular surgery. For the dental field, it supplies consumables, implant materials, and equipment. Furthermore, the company offers blood glucose monitors, along with their related consumables and nutritional products. Beyond product provision, Hi-Clearance Inc. delivers extensive hemodialysis management services and specializes in the development and operation of dialysis centers. Diversifying its business, the company also engages in the distribution and servicing of healthy and natural beverages, and acts as an OEM provider for beverage raw materials and concentrates.
